reason: Start skin renewal by supplying the DNA needed before cell division.
expectation: The cell will copy its DNA in preparation for separating chromosomes.

alternatives.reason: Blood-cell renewal also serves the goal, but I want to follow skin-cell division first.

effect: The chromosomes have been copied into joined sister chromatids, so I can follow their separation next.
reaction: The before-and-after comparison makes the copying step clear.
reason: Continue the skin-cell division sequence by separating the copied chromosomes.
expectation: The spindle machinery will separate the sister chromatids toward opposite poles, though the cell may not divide yet.

alternatives.reason: This would begin blood renewal, but I prefer to finish the skin-cell sequence first.

effect: The copied chromosomes are now in matching sets at opposite poles, but the cell still has one shared interior.
reaction: The distinction between chromosome separation and cell division is clear.
reason: Continue skin renewal by dividing the cell around the separated chromosome sets.
expectation: The division ring will constrict the membrane and produce two cells, each with a chromosome set.

alternatives.reason: Blood renewal is also part of the goal, but I want to finish this division sequence first.

effect: The division ring produced two daughter cells with complete chromosome sets; they can now be connected to the body.
reaction: The pinching sequence clearly completes the division process.
reason: Connect the new skin cells to the body before moving on to blood renewal.
expectation: The body will gain a skin-renewal component, though the blood-renewal goal may remain unfinished.

alternatives.reason: This starts blood-cell renewal, but I prefer to finish connecting the skin cells first.

effect: The body now shows new basal skin cells and surface shedding; blood renewal still needs attention.
reaction: The inset connects cell division to ongoing skin replacement.
reason: Follow the only offered gameplay action to begin blood-cell renewal.
expectation: Erythropoietin will signal the marrow precursors to produce more red blood cells, though the intermediate result is uncertain.

effect: The kidney's low-oxygen cue leads to a blood-borne signal and maturation of marrow precursors; the developing cells can now be connected to the body.
reaction: The sequence makes the kidney-to-marrow connection clear.
reason: Follow the only offered gameplay action to connect blood renewal to the body.
expectation: The body will show red-cell renewal alongside skin renewal, though I don't know whether that completes the goal.

effect: Skin and blood renewal are connected to the body, and a new goal asks for bone remodelling.
reaction: The kidney-to-marrow link gives blood renewal a clear purpose; the bone goal is a new direction.
reason: Follow the only offered gameplay action to begin remodelling the existing bone.
expectation: The bone-removing cells will remove some existing bone, likely preparing the patch for rebuilding.

effect: The bone-removing cells have removed old bone in a magnified patch, setting up the formation step.
reaction: The removal is clear, though its broader purpose is not yet shown.
reason: Follow the only offered gameplay action to rebuild the bone patch.
expectation: Bone-forming cells will lay down new bone in the patch, completing or advancing the remodelling goal.

effect: Bone-forming cells rebuilt the patch, completing the remodelling goal and the chapter.
reaction: The final inset ties renewal back to the arm, though the reason for remodelling remains brief.

mostWorthwhile.text: The skin-cell division sequence was most worthwhile: the planned comparisons distinguish copied chromosomes, their separation and the final division into two cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: The bone-removal step was least informative on its own: it showed old bone being removed without yet explaining why remodelling matters.

surprise.text: The kidney-to-marrow connection was interesting: a low-oxygen cue leads to a blood-borne signal and red-cell maturation.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a purpose in the sequence, but the bone-remodelling explanation remained brief. The available combinations guided the choices; I did not discover their compatibility myself.

continue.text: I would not personally choose another chapter: the planned biological connections were clear, but the largely prescribed sequence offered limited meaningful decisions.
